why: Shell cycle 1 (docs/v3/cycles/shell-1.md) did not converge: 6 P1, 7 P2, 6 P3. This cycle rebuilds the same three-page app on master once every fix row has shipped, to see whether the page kit now holds without the app reaching past it. docs/v3/CYCLES.md is the protocol.
what: Cycle 2 of the AppShell and page-kit area: build, measure, log, file. Protocol: docs/v3/CYCLES.md, which this brief only specialises. Start from the cycle 1 build in apps/playground/src/cycle/shell-1/: copy it to cycle/shell-2/ (routes under routes/cycle/shell-2/), delete every `cycle-shell-1:` workaround its fix row made removable, and log any that still cannot go.
owns: apps/playground/src/** (the cycle build only: new files plus nav registration)
change: Build a three-page app in the playground on the v3 shell with fixture data: (1) an overview with a PageBar (title, two actions, one filter), a stat row and a chart card; (2) a list page with a SplitPage master-detail and a PageAside inspector that opens from a row; (3) a settings page with InnerNav. Navigation comes from one nav definition: a phone tab bar with a More sheet, breadcrumbs, and a command palette entry per page. Exercise the phone (390x844), the docked aside (1800x1200), the collapsed rail, route errors, pending and missing states, and a keyboard-only pass through every page. Count: lines of layout glue the app wrote (wrappers, hand-built containers, calc() heights); escape hatches; places where the app had to know a shell internal (a CSS var, a data-slot, a z-index); keyboard traps and focus losses. Compare every number with docs/v3/cycles/shell-1.md.
commits: Playground build in its own commit (feat:), findings and plan rows in a docs: commit. No package commit.
proof: docs/v3/cycles/shell-2.md with the sha, the numbers, the shot paths and the findings table.
